# Helio Start — first mature day-90 cohort status-rate card

**Fixed cohort denominator: 52 workspaces.** All 52 have complete day-90 windows.

| Mutually exclusive workspace status at day 90 | Workspaces | Share of 52 |
|---|---:|---:|
| Paid and active | 39 | 75.0% |
| Canceled before day 90 | 7 | 13.5% |
| Past due | 4 | 7.7% |
| Billing hold | 2 | 3.8% |
| **Total** | **52** | **100.0%** |

The four statuses reconcile to the full fixed cohort: **39 + 7 + 4 + 2 = 52**. Percentages are derived from the 52-workspace denominator and rounded to one decimal place.

**Scope boundary:** This is a point-in-time day-90 workspace-status card only. Keep it separate from day-30 settled-cash reporting and later-refund reporting; neither is included or recalculated here.
